data.title: 莲华 · 散落和服下的初次解禁
data.description: 华贵的金丝腰带被彻底扯开，层叠的绯红和服在榻榻米上铺散成一朵盛开的彼岸花。一贯从容优雅的引路人此刻双颊绯红，十指死死抓紧席面，在狂乱的侵入下彻底融化。
data.location: grand traditional tatami suite with gold leaf painted screens and unrolled futon
data.action: sprawled on the floor amidst opulent unfolded silks, obi sash unfastened, crying out in helpless blissful breakdown as every defense shatters
data.lighting: warm floor lantern illuminating flush across bare collarbones and silky raven hair spread wide
data.mood: haughty composure completely shattered, profound erotic surrender, divine ecstasy
data.promptProse: Sprawled on tatami amidst rich unfolded kimono silks, Renge gasps with parted lips as unbridled ecstasy shatters her eternal cool composure.
data.animaCaption: Renge sprawled amidst luxurious silk kimono folds on tatami in pure helpless ecstasy.
